title: Forecast resolution is required for compounding predictive intelligence
problem: Powerhouse could produce many forecasts while only a small number had verified resolved outcomes, limiting reliable calibration and autonomous prediction improvement.
root_cause: Prediction generation and forecast calibration existed, but forecast-resolution coverage was not a first-class learning objective across Self-Improvement.
impact: Without resolution coverage, probability quality, timing quality and model improvements cannot be proven and prediction volume can create false confidence.
failed_approaches: Treating number of forecasts as evidence of predictive intelligence.
Improving prediction methods without enough resolved outcomes.
fix: Add canonical prediction quality, resolution debt, horizon calibration, scenario ensemble and evidence-driven challenger controls over the existing forecast tables.
prevention_rule: Every due forecast becomes explicit learning debt until resolved; method changes require resolved-outcome evidence and backtest-shadow-canary promotion.
outcome: Powerhouse can measure whether future predictions improve and generate bounded improvement challengers instead of merely generating more forecasts.
